title: Device enrolment fails
symptom: A new phone will not enrol in the company's device management
user_description: I got a new phone and the company app says enrolment failed. I've tried three times. I need my work email on it today.

options.text: Factory reset the phone again and again
options.why: Resetting does not fix account, licence or limit problems, and wastes time.

options.text: Let him use work email without enrolling
options.why: Breaks company policy and leaves company data unprotected on the phone.

options.text: Sign in with a colleague's account
options.why: Never use someone else's account. It also links the phone to the wrong person.

options.text: Check he is allowed to enrol and has a licence, the phone meets the minimum OS version, he signs in with his work account, and he has not hit the device limit (remove old devices first), then retry
options.why: Enrolment fails for a reason. These checks cover the usual causes, and removing old devices often fixes it straight away.

hints: Is he signing in with the right account?
Could his old phone still be counted against him?
Does the new phone meet the company's requirements?
real_world_tip: Device management tools usually limit how many devices each user can enrol. The exact number depends on how the company has set it up.
